papers.title: Better Measurement or Larger Samples? Data Collection for Policy Learning with Unobserved Heterogeneity
papers.abstract: Empirical research shows that individuals' responses to treatments vary along latent characteristics, such as innate ability or motivation. Therefore, a policymaker seeking to maximize welfare may consider designing policies based on observed characteristics and estimated latent traits. I characterize how the estimates' precision affects the worst-case performance of policies, deriving rate-sharp regret bounds for assignment rules that include or exclude them, highlighting new trade-offs with the policy space complexity. I then study how a policymaker can solve such trade-offs by designing tailored data collections, and derive the minimax optimal collection plan. In an empirical application in development economics, I show that including a proxy for entrepreneurs' business skills in targeting cash transfers increases welfare by 5%, and halves the probability of generating welfare losses. Moreover, I estimate the optimal allocation of resources between improving the precision of the proxy via repeated measurements and increasing sample size.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】实证研究表明，个体对不同治疗的反应会因其潜在特征（如先天能力或动机）而有所不同。因此，旨在最大化社会福利的政策制定者可以考虑根据观察到的特征和估算出的潜在特质来设计相关政策。我分析了估算精度的差异如何影响政策的最差表现，并为包含或排除这些潜在特征的分配规则制定了严格的遗憾值（regret bounds），指出了这些因素与政策空间复杂性之间的新矛盾。随后，我探讨了政策制定者如何通过设计针对性的数据收集方案来平衡这些矛盾，并推导出了最优的数据收集策略。在发展经济学的实证研究中，我发现：在现金转移政策中加入对企业家商业技能的代理指标可使社会福利提高5%，同时将导致福利损失的可能性降低一半。此外，我还估算了通过重复测量和提高样本量来提升该代理指标精度与增加资源分配之间的最佳平衡点。。

papers.title: Representativeness and Efficiency in Overidentified IV
papers.abstract: Under heterogeneous treatment effects, the GMM weighting matrix in overidentified IV models dictates the estimand. We show that efficient GMM downeights high-variance instruments and frequently assigning negative weights that undermine causal interpretation. Moreover, GMM cannot simultaneously achieve efficiency and accommodate researcher-specified weights. We resolve this trade-off by developing the Representative Targeting (RT) estimator. By averaging instrument-specific Wald estimators under Positive Regression Dependence, RT ensures non-negative weights while achieving the semiparametric efficiency bound for its targeted estimand. We demonstrate the heterogeneity penalty empirically in a class-size experiment and apply RT to recover the Policy-Relevant Treatment Effect within a patent leniency design.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在异质性处理效应的情况下，过度识别的工具变量（IV）模型中的广义矩估计（GMM）加权矩阵决定了估计量。我们发现，GMM方法会高估高方差工具变量的影响，并经常赋予这些工具变量负权重，从而削弱了因果关系的解释力。此外，GMM方法无法同时实现估计效率与研究者指定的权重要求。为了解决这一矛盾，我们提出了“代表性目标选择”（Representative Targeting, RT）估计量。该方法通过在对工具变量进行Wald估计时考虑其正相关性（Positive Regression Dependence），确保所有工具变量的权重均为非负值，同时仍能保持目标估计量的半参数效率界限。我们通过一个班级规模实验实证验证了异质性对估计结果的影响，并将RT方法应用于专利宽恕政策（patent leniency design）的研究中，成功恢复了与政策相关的处理效应（Policy-Relevant Treatment Effect）。。研究方法：回归分析、实验方法、广义矩估计。

papers.title: FDI and Fixed Capital Formation Private Sector in Emerging Economies: The Case of Egypt
papers.venue: International Journal of Economics and Finance
papers.abstract:
Emerging Economies, including Egypt, strive to increase domestic capital formation to achieve sustainable economic growth, create jobs, and achieve comprehensive development. This is accomplished by stimulating domestic savings and investment and encouraging foreign direct investment as a means of attracting new physical capital, in addition to several intangible assets such as technological capabilities, managerial skills, brands, international product marketing channels, and product design. 
 
This study examined the long-term relationship between net flows foreign direct investment and gross fixed capital formation of the private sector in Egypt during the period 1960-2024, a significant long-term relationship is evident between the dependent variable, gross fixed capital formation of the private sector in Egypt during the period under study (1960-2024), and all explanatory variables FDI, nominal exchange rate, gross domestic savings, real interest rate, Domestic credit to private sector, General government final consumption expenditure, and Claims on central government. Using EViews 12’s vector error correction (VEC), the analysis discovered a significant long-term inverse relationship between net foreign direct investment (FDI) flows and gross fixed capital formation of the private sector in Egypt during the study period. were, a 10% increase in net FDI flows resulted in a 7.2% decrease in gross fixed capital formation of the private sector in Egypt. The study also found a significant inverse relationship in the long run between the explanatory variables the nominal exchange rate, the real interest rate, and total government final consumption expenditure and the dependent variable, gross fixed capital formation in the private sector in Egypt during the study period. A 10% increase in the nominal exchange rate (currency depreciation) resulted in a 4.9% decrease in gross fixed capital formation in the private sector in Egypt, highlighting the importance of currency value stability (the Egyptian pound) for increasing private sector gross fixed capital formation in Egypt. Similarly, a 10% increase in the real interest rate led to a 7.4% decrease in private sector gross fixed capital formation in Egypt, and a 10% increase in government final consumption expenditure resulted in a 13.8 % decrease in private sector gross fixed capital formation in Egypt. 
 
Also, the study found a significant long-term positive relationship between the explanatory variables of gross domestic savings, Domestic credit to private sector, Domestic credit to private sector, and gross fixed capital formation of the private sector in Egypt during the period under study. An increase in gross domestic savings of 10% results in an increase in gross fixed capital formation of the private sector in Egypt of 0.3%. As for Domestic credit to private sector and Claims on central government, an increase of 10% leads to an increase of gross fixed capital formation of the private sector in Egypt 4.1% and 0.3%, respectively. 
 
Based on the preceding findings, the study recommends the following: First, focusing on attracting foreign direct investment (FDI) flows necessary for development, which complement, rather than displace, the private sector’s role in increasing gross fixed capital formation. Second, working to stabilize the Egyptian pound’s exchange rate, which improves expectations and encourages the private sector to engage in long-term projects that will increase gross fixed capital formation. Third, encouraging gross domestic savings while increasing credit extended to the private sector and attempting to reduce real interest rates, thereby increasing the private sector’s access to necessary capital at a reasonable cost.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】新兴经济体（包括埃及）致力于增加国内资本形成，以实现可持续的经济增长、创造就业机会并实现全面发展。这主要通过刺激国内储蓄和投资来实现，并通过吸引外国直接投资（FDI）来引入新的实物资本，以及各种无形资产，如技术能力、管理技能、品牌、国际产品营销渠道和产品设计。

本研究考察了1960年至2024年间埃及私营部门净外国直接投资（FDI）流量与私营部门固定资本形成总额之间的长期关系。研究发现，在研究期间（1960–2024年），私营部门固定资本形成总额与所有解释变量（FDI、名义汇率、国内储蓄总额、实际利率、对私营部门的国内信贷、政府最终消费支出以及对中央政府的债权）之间存在显著的长期相关性。利用EViews 12的向量误差修正（VEC）模型进行分析后，发现净FDI流量与埃及私营部门固定资本形成总额之间存在显著的长期负相关关系：净FDI流量每增加10%，私营部门固定资本形成总额就会减少7.2%。此外，从长期来看，名义汇率、实际利率和政府最终消费支出也与私营部门固定资本形成总额之间存在显著的负相关关系——名义汇率上升10%（即货币贬值）会导致私营部门固定资本形成总额减少4.9%；实际利...。

papers.title: Financial development, green energy security and income inequality: dynamic panel quantile regression approach
papers.abstract:
This paper examines the relationship between financial development, green energy security, and income inequality for emerging and developing economies.
 
 
 
 The authors use dynamic panel quantile regression with nonadditive fixed effects for a sample of 112 emerging and developing economies spanning from 2001 to 2021.
 
 
 
 The findings demonstrate that financial development has a nonlinear relationship with income inequality. The interaction term between financial development and green energy security indicates that there is an inverted U-shaped relationship.
 
 
 
 Limited studies have investigated the combined impact of financial development and green energy security on inequality. The majority of previous research has focused on the relationship between financial development and inequality or the relationship between energy security and inequality. The combined impact of these two variables on income inequality has not been examined in previous studies.
papers.summary_zh:
【收入分配与福利】本文探讨了金融发展、绿色能源安全与新兴和发展中经济体收入不平等之间的关系。

作者采用动态面板分位数回归方法（结合非加性固定效应模型），对2001年至2021年间112个新兴和发展中经济体的数据进行了分析。

研究结果表明，金融发展与收入不平等之间存在非线性关系；金融发展与绿色能源安全之间的交互项显示了一种倒U形关系。

目前关于金融发展与绿色能源安全共同对收入不平等影响的实证研究较为有限。以往的大部分研究主要集中在金融发展与收入不平等之间的关系，或能源安全与收入不平等之间的关系上，而这两个变量共同对收入不平等产生的综合影响尚未得到充分探讨。。研究方法：回归分析、固定效应。

papers.title: Can Personal Access to Medical Expertise Overcome Vaccine Hesitancy? -- by D. Mark Anderson, Ron Diris, Raymond Montizaan, Daniel I. Rees
papers.abstract: Using data on applicants to Dutch medical schools and their older relatives (i.e., parents, aunts, and uncles ages 60+), we estimate the effect of personal access to medical expertise on vaccine hesitancy.  Leveraging variation in lottery outcomes that determine admission to medical schools, we find that having a physician in the family increases the likelihood of complying with government recommendations that anyone over the age of 59 receive a second booster dose of a COVID-19 vaccine.  Our estimated effects are strongest for having a female physician in the family, suggesting important gender-based differences in how medical expertise is communicated.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们利用了申请荷兰医学院的学生及其年长亲属（即父母、阿姨和叔叔，年龄在60岁以上）的相关数据，来研究个人接触医学专业知识对疫苗接种意愿的影响。通过分析决定医学院录取结果的随机分配机制（即“抽签”结果），我们发现家庭中如果有医生，那么59岁以上人群遵循政府关于接种第二剂新冠疫苗的建议的可能性会增加。研究发现，这种影响在家庭中有女性医生的情况下最为显著，这表明在医学专业知识的传递过程中存在基于性别的差异。。

papers.title: Why Do Americans No Longer Work So Much More Than Non-Americans? -- by Serdar Birinci, Loukas Karabarbounis, Kurt See
papers.abstract: In the 1990s, Americans used to work much more than non-Americans. Nowadays, about half of the gap in hours worked has reversed. To evaluate the convergence of working hours, we develop a tractable  model of labor supply enriched with multiple sources of heterogeneity across individuals, an extensive margin of participation, multi-member households, and an elaborate system of taxes and benefits upon non-employment. Using detailed measurements from micro-level and aggregate datasets, we identify model parameters and sources of heterogeneity across individuals for various countries. We run a horse race between competing explanations and find that U.S. hours per person declined after 2000 owing mainly to the rise of government health benefits provided to the non-employed. Non-U.S. countries have generous benefits for the non-employed, but this generosity has not changed as much over time as in the United States, and public health coverage does not depend on employment status or income levels. For these countries, the rise of labor supply is generally accounted for by a mix of factors, such as the rise of wages and the falling disutility of work.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】20世纪90年代，美国人的工作时间明显长于非美国人。如今，这种工作时间差距已有所缩小，大约一半的差距已经消失。为了评估工作时间趋同的趋势，我们构建了一个易于处理的劳动力供给模型，该模型充分考虑了个体间的多种异质性、广泛的参与度、多成员家庭结构，以及针对非就业者的复杂税收和福利制度。通过利用微观和宏观数据集的详细信息，我们确定了各国家庭的模型参数及个体间异质性的来源。通过对各种解释进行比较分析，我们发现：自2000年以来，美国人均工作时间减少的主要原因是政府为非就业者提供了更多的健康福利。虽然非美国国家也为非就业者提供了较为优厚的福利，但这些福利的变动幅度不如美国那么显著，且公共卫生保障并不依赖于就业状况或收入水平。在这些国家，劳动力供给的增加通常由多种因素共同作用所致，例如工资水平的上升以及工作带来的负效用（即工作带来的不愉快感）的降低。。

papers.title: Seasonality in Mixed Causal-Noncausal Processes
papers.abstract: This paper investigates the role of complex and negative roots in mixed causal-noncausal autoregressive (MAR) models. Using partial fraction decompositions, we show that seasonal roots can always be isolated in the moving average representation of purely causal and noncausal AR models. We find that this result extends to the MAR model, which means that no new joint seasonal effects can be generated despite the multiplicative structure of the causal and noncausal polynomials. This results has important consequences for the MAR model selection procedure and these are extensively studied in a Monte Carlo simulation study. An empirical application on COVID-19 and soybean data illustrates the main findings of the paper.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文研究了复杂负根在混合因果-非因果自回归（MAR）模型中的作用。通过部分分式分解，我们证明了在纯因果和非因果AR模型的移动平均表示中，季节性根总是可以被分离出来的。我们发现这一结果同样适用于MAR模型，这意味着尽管因果和非因果多项式具有乘法结构，也不会产生新的联合季节性效应。这一发现对MAR模型的选择过程具有重要意义，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟研究进行了深入探讨。以COVID-19和大豆数据为实证案例，本文的主要研究结果得到了验证。。研究方法：蒙特卡洛模拟、数值模拟。

papers.title: Testing for Monotone Equilibrium Strategies in Games of Incomplete Information
papers.abstract: This paper develops a unified framework for testing monotonicity of Bayesian Nash equilibrium strategies in unobserved types in games of incomplete information. We show that, under symmetric independent private types, monotonicity of differentiable equilibrium strategies is equivalent to monotonicity of a quasi-inverse strategy identified from observed actions. This allows the problem to be reformulated as testing a countable set of moment inequalities involving unconditional expectations. We propose a Cramer-von Mises-type statistic with bootstrap critical values. The method accommodates covariates and game heterogeneity. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate finite-sample performance, and an application to procurement auctions illustrates cartel detection.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文构建了一个统一的框架，用于检验不完全信息博弈中贝叶斯纳什均衡策略的单调性（这些策略涉及未观测到的类型）。我们证明了，在对称独立私有类型的情况下，可微均衡策略的单调性等价于从观测到的行为中识别出的“准逆策略”的单调性。这使得该问题可以重新表述为检验一组涉及无条件期望的矩不等式。我们提出了一种基于克拉美-冯·米塞斯（Cramer-von Mises）统计量的方法，并为其提供了自举临界值。该方法能够考虑协变量和博弈的异质性。蒙特卡洛模拟验证了该方法的有限样本性能，而其在采购拍卖中的应用则展示了其在卡特尔检测方面的有效性。。研究方法：贝叶斯方法、蒙特卡洛模拟、均衡模型、数值模拟。

papers.title: SoK of RWA Tokenization: A Systematization of Concepts, Architectures, and Legal Interoperability
papers.abstract: The global financial architecture is undergoing a shift from intermediary centric-settlement to programmable infrastructure, to transmute trillions in static illiquid capital into active, high-velocity instruments. We argue that Real World Asset (RWA) tokenization represents a conceptual evolution beyond mere digitization, converting passive ledger entries into programmable economic agents capable of autonomous settlement and algorithmic collateralization. However, achieving such seamless capital efficiency necessitates resolving the fundamental friction between deterministic on-chain code and probabilistic off-chain reality, navigating the oracle problem and jurisdictional interoperability. This systematization of knowledge presents a taxonomy for the RWA lifecycle and deconstructs the multi-layered architecture, spanning legal custody, technical standards, and cryptoeconomic valuation, required to enforce off-chain rights within on-chain environments. We study systemic constraints such as latency and regulatory fragmentation through a comparative overview of sovereign debt, private credit, and real estate protocols, complemented by an empirical case study of on-chain U.S. Treasuries. We synthesize these findings to propose a prognostic outlook, positing that while asset tokenization provides a transitional bridge, it is not necessarily the inevitable shift compared to the emergence of unified, programmable ledgers.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】全球金融架构正在从以中介机构为中心的结算模式向可编程基础设施模式转变，这一转变旨在将数万亿美元的静态、流动性较差的资本转化为活跃的、高流动性的金融工具。我们认为，实物资产（Real World Assets, RWA）的代币化不仅仅是一种简单的数字化过程，它代表着一种概念上的进化——将原本被动的账本记录转化为能够自主完成结算和算法化抵押操作的可编程经济实体。然而，要实现这种无缝的资本效率，必须解决链上确定性代码与链下不确定性现实之间的根本性矛盾，同时应对“预言机问题”（oracle problem）以及不同司法管辖区之间的互操作性问题。这种知识体系的系统化构建为实物资产的生命周期提供了一个分类框架，并剖析了其中涉及的法律托管、技术标准以及加密经济学估值等多个层面，这些要素都是确保链下权利在链上环境中得以实现的关键。我们通过对比分析主权债务、私人信贷和房地产相关的区块链协议，探讨了诸如交易延迟和监管碎片化等系统性制约因素，并以美国国债的链上交易案例作为实证研究。综合这些研究结果，我们提出了一种预测性观点：虽然资产代币化确实为金融体系转型提供了过渡路径，但与统一、可编程的区块链技术相...。

papers.title: The Screening Cost of Liquidity
papers.abstract: A principal with cheap capital optimally forces her counterparty to borrow at above-market rates. The reason: the form of finance is a screening device. Advances provide liquidity but pool types; contingent transfers separate types, but, because they are not pledgeable, impose financing costs. The optimal contract preserves outside-finance exposure to maintain screening power. Two sufficient statistics pin down the optimal advance share. With complementary counterparties, a uniform subsidy that cheapens finance across every relationship can reduce the value of each. This explains the coexistence of early payment and contingent compensation in trade credit, venture capital, and internal capital markets.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】一位拥有低成本资金的主体会迫使对手方以高于市场水平的利率借款。其原因在于：这种融资形式实际上起到了一种“筛选”机制的作用。预付款项能够提供流动性，但同时也会将不同类型的交易主体混合在一起；而具有条件性的资金转移虽然能够区分这些交易主体，但由于这些转移款项不能用于抵押，因此会带来额外的融资成本。为了保持这种筛选能力，最优的合同设计会保留主体对外部融资的依赖性。通过两个关键的统计量，可以确定预付款项的最佳比例。当交易对手具有互补性时，对所有交易关系都提供统一的补贴虽然能够降低融资成本，但也会降低整体交易的价值。这解释了在贸易信贷、风险投资以及内部资本市场中，提前付款与条件性补偿机制为何能够同时存在。。

papers.title: Justifiable Priority Violations
papers.abstract: Addressing the large inefficiencies generated by the Deferred Acceptance (DA) mechanism requires priority violations, but which ones are justifiable? The leading approach is to ask individuals if they consent to waive their priority ex-ante. We develop an alternative question-free solution, in which a priority violation is justifiable whenever the affected student either (i) directly benefits from the improvement, or (ii) is unimprovable under any assignment that Pareto-dominates DA. This endogenous justifiability criterion permits improvements unattainable by the leading consent-based mechanism under any consent structure. We provide a ``just below cutoffs'' mechanism that always finds a strongly justifiable matching whenever DA's outcome is inefficient, and build on it to construct a polynomial-time algorithm that expands justifiable improvements iteratively, converging to a DA improvement that cannot be Pareto-improved by any justifiable matching without strictly expanding the beneficiary set. Finally, we prove theoretically that both the ex-ante consent and the endogenous justifiability frameworks have important limitations in reaching Pareto-efficient outcomes, and use simulations to quantify how binding these constraints are in practice.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】为了解决延迟接受（Deferred Acceptance, DA）机制所导致的高效率低下问题，通常需要违反优先级规则，但哪些情况下的优先级违反是合理的呢？目前的主要方法是事先询问参与者是否同意放弃自己的优先权。我们提出了一种无需提问的替代方案：当受影响的学生（i）直接从改进措施中受益，或者（ii）在任何优于DA的分配方案下都无法得到改善时，优先级违反就是合理的。这种基于内在合理性的标准允许实施那些在现有基于同意的机制中无论如何都无法实现的改进措施。我们设计了一种“略低于临界值的”匹配算法，当DA的结果效率低下时，该算法总能找到一个具有高度合理性的匹配方案；在此基础上，我们进一步开发了一个多项式时间复杂度的算法，该算法能够逐步扩大可实施的改进范围，最终得到一个无法通过其他合理匹配方案进行帕累托改进的改进结果（且不会扩大受益者的范围）。最后，我们从理论上证明了无论是事先征得同意的方式还是基于内在合理性的方法，在实现帕累托高效结果方面都存在显著局限性，并通过模拟实验来量化这些约束在实践中的实际约束力。。研究方法：数值模拟。

papers.title: Determinants of deposits in an emerging banking system: evidence from Mongolia
papers.summary_zh: 本文属于「银行与信贷」领域，主题为：Determinants of deposits in an emerging banking system: evidence from Mongolia。涉及关键词：Economics。原文未提供摘要，建议通过 DOI 链接查看全文以了解具体研究方法与结论。
